name: Londontown
description: Clean, cruelty-free nail care and color brand (lakur polishes, kur treatments) built on botanical, 9-free vegan-friendly formulas, sold direct and through major beauty retailers.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky lists LONDONTOWN's affiliate program as officially listed on ShareASale: 25% commission per sale, 60-day cookie, all regions.

No earnings-cap statement appears in the fetched program listing, so the cap is recorded as unknown; Shopper's lower 5-10% generic range conflicts with the 25% figure carried by LinkClicky, Lasso and the Awin merchant-profile text, which agree with each other.

opportunity.headline: 25% ShareASale commission - the highest verified rate in this group
opportunity.angle: Clean nail-care routines, at-home manicure systems and shade-launch content for a botanical, cruelty-free polish brand.

reasons.niche_fit: Core beauty brand - clean nail color and care is a staple creator category.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Open network program on ShareASale plus heavy TikTok Shop affiliate activity reported for the brand.
reasons.compensation: 25% per sale with a 60-day cookie is top-tier for beauty; no cap statement published, so cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email found on fetched pages; contact runs through the network.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is open to apply on ShareASale in all regions.
reasons.credibility: Established clean-beauty brand stocked at major retailers.

name: Alleyoop
description: Multi-tasking beauty brand (11th Hour eyeshadow sticks, Multi-Tasker 4-in-1 brush, tinted SPF) making clean, vegan, cruelty-free products designed to simplify routines.

evidence.summary: Alleyoop's own Dream Team Creator Program terms (updated 12/15/2025) state creators earn a ten percent commission on net revenues - net of taxes, shipping, refunds, chargebacks, fraud and non-link discounts - via a unique referral link or code.
The terms publish no earnings cap, so the cap is recorded as unknown; directory listings claiming 12-15% (Impact/Awin/Lasso) conflict with the brand's own 10%-of-net-revenue terms, which govern here.

opportunity.headline: Own creator program paying 10% of net revenue, terms published in full
opportunity.angle: Five-minute routine and multi-tasking product demos; the brand licenses creator content for paid and organic use, so strong videos can earn twice.

reasons.niche_fit: Core beauty brand built entirely around creator-friendly multi-use products.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Named creator program with published terms, content licensing and paid-usage commission rules.
reasons.compensation: 10% of net revenue is mid-range and the net basis pays less than a gross-sales rate; no cap stated.
reasons.contact_access: Full program terms and application route published on the brand's own site.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC beauty brand with national retail presence.

name: Jouer Cosmetics
description: Clean beauty makeup brand (founded by Christina Zilber) known for skin-friendly, paraben-free color cosmetics and skincare-makeup hybrids.

evidence.summary: Jouer's own affiliate page invites creators to apply for discounts, commissions and prizes, stating affiliates earn up to 15% commission on all sales made through their link, with higher commissions for top earners.

LinkClicky lists the program on ShareASale at 10% per sale with a 30-day cookie; the 10% network rate is recorded, with the brand page's 'up to 15%' treated as a ceiling for top earners, not the base rate. No cap statement is published.

opportunity.headline: Clean-beauty staple with up to 15% for top earners on ShareASale
opportunity.angle: Clean-girl makeup routines and skin-first product demos for a long-running indie brand with a loyal creator following.

reasons.niche_fit: Core beauty brand - clean color cosmetics are a central creator niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Own affiliate page plus a listed ShareASale program.
reasons.compensation: 10% base on ShareASale rising toward 15% for top earners per the brand's own page.
reasons.contact_access: Application page published on the brand's own site.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to apply; approval at the brand's discretion.

name: Polite Society
description: Clean makeup brand founded by Too Faced co-founders Jerrod Blandino and Jeremy Johnson (B.I.G Mouth lip plumper, Polite Pops), launched 2023 and sold at Ulta Beauty.

evidence.summary: Polite Society's own Socialites page offers commissions on all products purchased through a creator's link, a welcome package and early launch access; its sign-up button routes to app.impact.com, confirming Impact as the platform.
LinkClicky lists Polite Society Beauty on Impact at 10% per sale as the officially listed payout. No earnings-cap statement is published.
Glossy reports the brand seeded product to more than 1,000 TikTok Shop affiliate creators for its largest affiliate campaign - evidence of heavy creator saturation, so saturation is not low.

opportunity.headline: Too Faced founders' brand actively scaling creator affiliates
opportunity.angle: Before-and-after lip plumper demos and clean-makeup routines; the brand is investing heavily in affiliate creators right now.

reasons.niche_fit: Core beauty brand - viral hero products built for short-form demos.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Own creator program on Impact plus a 1,000+ creator TikTok Shop campaign reported by Glossy.
reasons.compensation: 10% per sale on Impact is mid-range; no cap published.
reasons.contact_access: Application page on the brand's own site with a stated 48-hour review.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application for creators with a public social account or blog.
reasons.credibility: Founded by the Too Faced co-founders; stocked at Ulta Beauty.

name: Lawless Beauty
description: Clean, high-performance makeup brand (Forget the Filler line) making non-toxic, cruelty-free color cosmetics sold direct and at Sephora.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky lists Lawless Beauty's affiliate program on Impact at 10% per sale, described as the officially listed payout, with application routed through app.impact.com.
No earnings-cap or creator-count figures are published in the fetched listing, so cap and saturation are recorded as unknown.

opportunity.headline: Sephora-stocked clean makeup brand on Impact at 10%
opportunity.angle: Clean-makeup full-face routines and plumping-product demos for a performance-focused brand.

reasons.niche_fit: Core beauty brand - clean color cosmetics are a central creator niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Listed affiliate program on Impact; no separate creator page was fetched.
reasons.compensation: 10% per sale is mid-range for beauty; no cap published.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through Impact; no public partnerships email found on fetched pages.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to apply on Impact in all regions per the listing.
reasons.credibility: Established clean beauty brand stocked at Sephora.

name: Fur
description: Body and pubic hair care brand (Fur Oil, Ingrown Concentrate) making dermatologist- and gynecologist-tested, plant-based, vegan products for ingrowns, KP and sensitive skin.

evidence.summary: LinkMyDeals' campaign records for furyou.com list a ShareASale campaign at 'Sale Commission: 10%' and a Skimlinks campaign at minimum 10% CPA, plus an Awin listing with rates inside the panel.

Cap note: Fur's separate Professionals (trade) program advertises no-limit earnings, but that is a professional-only program and does not make the consumer ShareASale program uncapped - the consumer cap stays unknown.

opportunity.headline: Niche body-care leader paying 10% on ShareASale
opportunity.angle: Ingrown-hair and body-care education content - an underserved, high-intent niche with little creator competition in feeds.

reasons.niche_fit: Skincare-adjacent body care with a distinctive, ownable niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Campaigns listed on ShareASale, Skimlinks and Awin.
reasons.compensation: 10% per sale is mid-range; consumer-program cap is not published.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email found on fetched pages; contact runs through the networks.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open network campaigns to apply to.
reasons.credibility: Category-defining brand featured in Vogue and Refinery29.

name: Ole Henriksen
description: Heritage Scandinavian skincare brand (Truth Serum, Banana Bright, Pout Preserve) built on vitamin C and the 'Ole Glow', owned by Kendo Brands.

evidence.summary: WOW TRK's Rakuten Advertising offer record for Ole Henriksen (offer ID 38834, updated 21 Nov 2026) lists a 4% base commission and a 7-day cookie; the program is also listed on FlexOffers.
Shopper's generic 'up to 6.4%' figure conflicts with the network offer record's 4% base; the network record governs. No earnings-cap statement is published.

opportunity.headline: Prestige skincare name on Rakuten - low 4% rate, high brand trust
opportunity.angle: Glow-routine and vitamin C education content; best for creators monetizing prestige skincare audiences despite the low rate.

reasons.niche_fit: Core skincare brand - a prestige staple of creator routines.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Live network offers on Rakuten Advertising and FlexOffers.
reasons.compensation: 4% base with a short 7-day cookie is well below beauty norms; no cap published.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the networks; no public partnerships email found on fetched pages.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open network offer to apply to.
reasons.credibility: Decades-old prestige brand under Kendo/LVMH with mass retail distribution.

name: Ofra Cosmetics
description: Florida-made professional makeup and skincare brand (highlighters, long-wear liquid lipsticks) manufactured in its own Pompano Beach facility and sold in 70+ countries.

evidence.summary: OFRA's own affiliate page runs an Affiliate Tracking Program where approved partners earn commission on products sold and can view each sale and commission; applications require emailing a W-9 to denise@ofracosmetics.com.

LinkClicky lists OFRA on Rakuten Advertising at 6% per sale (also carried in FMTC's merchant record at 6%, 10 return days); the brand's own page publishes no percentage. No cap statement is published.

opportunity.headline: Pro makeup brand with a direct, human application route
opportunity.angle: Highlighter and long-wear lip demos; the manual W-9 application suits serious beauty creators who want a direct brand relationship.

reasons.niche_fit: Core beauty brand - professional makeup is a staple creator category.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Own affiliate tracking program plus a Rakuten Advertising listing.
reasons.compensation: 6% per sale is below the beauty mid-range; no cap published.
reasons.contact_access: Named affiliate contact email and a general support email published on the brand's own program page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application, but approval is manual and requires a W-9.
reasons.credibility: Long-running US manufacturer-brand with global distribution.

name: Dazzle Dry
description: Arizona-made quick-dry nail system (VB Cosmetics) - a vegan, cruelty-free, non-toxic 4-step manicure system that dries in five minutes without UV light.

evidence.summary: Dazzle Dry's own affiliate page invites anyone 18+ - explicitly including small, engaged communities - to earn commission on every sale; its Join Now buttons route to ui.awin.com, confirming Awin as the network, and it names support@dazzledry.com as the affiliate team email.
The brand publishes no commission percentage, and directory figures conflict wildly (2-10% across aggregator pages), so the rate is recorded as null; no cap or creator-count figures are published.

opportunity.headline: Small-creator-friendly nail system on Awin - rate confirmed only inside the panel
opportunity.angle: Five-minute manicure and nail-health content; the brand explicitly welcomes micro-creators, a rare open door in nail care.

reasons.niche_fit: Beauty brand in the nail niche - a strong but narrower creator category.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Own affiliate page routing to Awin signup.
reasons.compensation: Commission exists on every sale but the percentage is not published anywhere fetched, so it scores low until confirmed in-panel.
reasons.contact_access: Affiliate team email published on the brand's own program page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to anyone 18+, explicitly including small audiences.
reasons.credibility: Established niche manufacturer (VB Cosmetics, Chandler AZ) with a smaller public footprint.

name: LolaVie
description: Jennifer Aniston's haircare brand - clean, plant-powered shampoos, conditioners and the Glossing Detangler, sold direct and at Ulta Beauty.

evidence.summary: Rateful's TikTok Shop data page confirms LolaVie runs a TikTok Shop affiliate program: about 67% of its estimated $26.4K in TikTok Shop sales in the 30 days to Nov 6, 2026 came through affiliate creators, who add products to their showcase and earn commission on every sale.
TikTok Shop commission percentages are set per product inside the app and are not published in the fetched source, so the rate is recorded as null; no cap or creator-count figures are published.

opportunity.headline: Celebrity-founded haircare selling mostly through TikTok Shop affiliates
opportunity.angle: Hair routine and detangler demos inside TikTok Shop, where two-thirds of the brand's sales already come from creators.

reasons.niche_fit: Beauty/haircare brand with strong creator-native products.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Two-thirds of TikTok Shop sales attributed to affiliate creators - unusually direct evidence of creator demand.
reasons.compensation: Commission exists on every TikTok Shop sale but the percentage is not published in fetched sources.
reasons.contact_access: Joining runs inside TikTok Shop; no public partnerships contact found on fetched pages.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to any creator with TikTok Shop affiliate access.
reasons.credibility: Celebrity-founded brand with Ulta Beauty distribution.
